content:
Backend engineers design reliable APIs and maintain backward compatibility.

They define versioning policies and deprecation paths to avoid breaking clients.

Debugging practices start with a production incident timeline and root-cause analysis. Engineers trace failures through logs and monitoring.

API design should document compatibility contracts.

Test reliability requires deterministic tests, reproducible regressions, and reliable CI.

They monitor production rollouts and compare service behavior after release.

CI pipelines should include deterministic tests and flaky-test detection.

Use retries only with diagnostics, and track failure rates over time.
Frontend engineering standards define component boundaries, accessibility, and responsive layouts. Document compatibility contracts. Test UI regressions with deterministic checks and reliable waits.

Frontend engineers focus on usability, accessibility, and responsive layouts.

They prioritize component consistency and design-system alignment.
